author: whiteveR
body:
This is a map I made for the Overcast Network some time ago, but now that is closing I've decided to adapt it to the Avicus.


It's a Destroy the monument, 2 monuments by team, with 3 obsidian pieces each.

There is iron mines following the left path at spawn.

Spawn kit:





Album [http://imgur.com/a/b1ao9]
Download [http://www.mediafire.com/download/u7n3d35dx39dcyq/Amazon+Kingdom+av.zip]
The XML file is inside the Download ^

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Awesome map, I can do the XML for ya if ya wish... all that I ask of you fellow map makers is to...

PLACE. XML. IN. A. PASTEBIN. LIKE. HASTEBIN.

It's too much work downloading a map just to get it's XML. It'd be redundant and time wasting when I could just get the XML and be done with it.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I know, I just want to check. People make mistakes and OCN's XML is much different compared to Avicus' XML.

It's good to be sure that your XML is properly debugged otherwise you'll regret not letting the public look it over for mistakes.

It also makes XML debuggers jobs much faster and less redundant.
